remarks: Stunning 2-Bedroom Waterfront Condo with Exceptional Views:  Welcome to The Village at Stamford Landing! This spacious 2-bedroom, 2-full bath condo offers 1,415 square feet of open, sun-drenched living space designed for comfort and style. Soaring 9-foot ceilings enhance the sense of space and airiness, while oversized windows frame breathtaking views of Stamford Harbor, the canal, and the Long Island Sound. The thoughtfully designed layout features a bright and inviting living area, perfect for entertaining or relaxing while enjoying the ever-changing waterfront scenery. The primary suite boasts a full bath and generous closet space, while the second bedroom and bathroom offer ideal accommodations for guests or a home office setup.  Whether you're sipping your morning coffee as the sun rises over the water or unwinding with a glass of wine at sunset, this condo offers the perfect backdrop for coastal living. Pool and spa below complete your new waterfront lifestyle. Don't miss the chance to make this exceptional residence your new home!
